context: M7 o7. The Shamrock Rail, end of the bar. Mayhew alone with a beer and a racing form.

lines.speaker: char.carl_mayhew
lines.text: Kid. Sit. Knew you'd come. Nobody says no in July.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: The Corwin. They're giving old men thirty days.

lines.speaker: char.carl_mayhew
lines.text: So say yes, and I make a call, and the Corwin stays open through Labor Day.

choices.text: Yes. For two hundred a week.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Before I say anything. You and H. Lisle, counsel. Pennsylvania lobby. Friday.

lines.speaker: char.carl_mayhew
lines.text: Where'd you get a camera? Put that away. Put it away, Teddy.

lines.speaker: char.carl_mayhew
lines.text: He's a lawyer. I know lawyers. Everybody knows lawyers. Yes or no?

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Yes. And the Corwin stays open.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Yes. And the Corwin stays open. Every room.

lines.speaker: char.carl_mayhew
lines.text: Here's the first week and the list. Collect Thursday. Fourth of July, nice and quiet.
